turns.belt: How do I calculate the cost of the gap?
turns.answer:
To calculate the cost of the gap, we multiply the number of defects (in this case, late closures) by the cost per defect. Here's how it works for your project:

- You handle about 1,200 complaints a year (confirmed).
- Each late closure costs about €45 in callbacks and rework (confirmed).

1,200 complaints × 38% × €45 = €20,520 a year.
